summary: No new defects found by static review. Both prior Codex fixes and both Claude rebuttals are supported by the inspected files. Execution-dependent criteria and required checks remain unverified because this read-only review explicitly prohibits running checks.

checks.criterion: AC1: Deterministic tile selection, anonymous regional HTTPS URL, and header/window range readers in io.py.
checks.evidence: pilot.py:4971-5075 defines the regional endpoint, ordered candidates and range fetch; io.py:1508-1639 implements the header-aware reader. Saved tileList.txt:11553 lists the Holuhraun tile. Fetch execution was prohibited by the read-only review instructions.

checks.criterion: AC2: cop30_range_read.json contains all required HTTP, COG, spatial, elevation and surface-model fields.
checks.evidence: outputs/pilot/cop30_range_read.json:18-273 contains the layout, overviews, EPSG:4326, pixel sizes, status 206, Content-Range, object size, requested/received bytes, units, nodata, datum and elevation statistics. The vegetation/buildings caveat is at :423-436. Values were inspected, not independently recomputed.

checks.criterion: AC3: A stated 5 km square, complete byte accounting, touched-tile count, observational budget reporting, and no whole-tile download.
checks.evidence: pilot.py:4915-4943 constructs the UTM square; :5598-5619 reports the budget without failing it. The artifact records 2,883,584 bytes, one touched tile and a 4,000,000-byte limit at outputs/pilot/cop30_range_read.json:144-153. Tests cover over-budget success at test_pilot_cop30.py:828-836. Behavioral execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC4: Sorted ProductRecord upsert with provider attribution, checksum and a local file holding exactly the fetched ranges.
checks.evidence: outputs/sources.json:2-22 contains the COP30 record. pilot.py:341-365 sorts and replaces source records; :5061-5075 saves fetched bytes. io.py:660-682 computes and validates the local checksum. Exact-byte and checksum verification was not executed under the review instructions.

checks.criterion: AC5: An unreachable bucket causes non-zero exit naming the URL and error.
checks.evidence: io.py:802-807 and :949-954 attach URLs to HTTP/connection errors; pilot.py:576-578 returns 1. test_pilot_cop30.py:588-626 exercises HTTP failures, an inaccessible tile and refused connections. These tests require execution and temporary files, which this review prohibits.

checks.criterion: AC6: Fetch persists raw files and HTTP metadata; record/check operate offline and check compares committed bytes.
checks.evidence: data/raw/cop30/fetch.json:71-135 contains saved ranges and per-request metadata. pilot.py:5034-5095 persists them; :5099-5261 builds from local files; :508-522 compares output bytes. Offline and changed-output tests are at test_pilot_cop30.py:1004-1019. Offline reproduction was not executed as instructed.
